create_mae_image_dataset: create a MaeImageDataset from an ImageFolder root with configurable mask probability and patch size
use_caching_loader: use caching_loader to wrap a torchvision loader with a local cache directory for faster image loading
apply_random_resized_crop_transform: apply RandomResizedCropAndInterpolationWithTwoPic to crop and resize PIL images with random aspect ratio
compute_mae_mask: compute a precomputed block mask for MAE image patches using compute_block_mask_1d or compute_block_mask_2d
collate_mae_samples: collate MaeImageDataset samples into batched tensors with optional target and precomputed mask keys
